{{Quote|Mark One Power Guards. Not as destructive as the later models I possess, but quick to assemble and quite malleable.|Sadic|<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" />}}
'''Mark I Power Guards''' were the first model of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] augmented with the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]], a supersoldier program developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]] acquired control of the Power Guard project in [[3643 BBY]], he manufactured Power Guards using [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and wiped their minds, transforming them into mindless weapons for him to control. Mark I Power Guards were the weakest model of Power Guard but were equipped with advanced weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] like later models. Several Mark I Power Guards were left to [[Skirmish in the Power Guard Cybernetics Lab|defend]] the [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab]] after Sadic moved the program elsewhere, though they were no match for a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who arrived not long afterward. After Sadic's defeat, the entire project was scuttled.

==History==
The [[Power Guard Enhancement System]] was developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Republic superweapon initiative]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Power Guard system was applied to willing recruits on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" /> but in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]] seized control of the project and set about using it for his own ends. Instead of using willing volunteers, his forces began abducting [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and forcing them to undergo the Power Guard process&mdash;but their minds were also wiped and programmed, giving Sadic [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-like [[Soldier/Legends|supersoldiers]].<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" />

When a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] began disrupting Sadic's operations, Sadic relocated the Power Guard program to [[Sadic's laboratory|another location]], leaving only a handful of Mark I Power Guards along with his subordinate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Graul (Human)|Graul]] at the original [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and a companion soon located the facility and [[Skirmish in the Power Guard Cybernetics Lab|stormed]] the building. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] breached the main chamber, the Knight briefly spoke with Sadic via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], and then Sadic activated the remaining Mark I Power Guards stored in the [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] to support Graul. However, the Knight and a companion [[Death/Legends|killed]] Graul and the Power Guards.<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The Power Guard program came to an end not long afterward, with the Republic destroying all of the program's files.<ref name="Showdown with Lord Sadic">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Showdown with Lord Sadic|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Characteristics==
A Mark I Power Guard was a supersoldier augmented with the Power Guard Enhancement System&mdash;an array of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements and [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] stimulants. Each Mark I Power Guard was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] individual who underwent the Power Guard modifications, and thus every individual Power Guard was unique in height, weight, and [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. The Power Guard system was originally intended to produce supersoldiers who retained their personalities and individualism, but when Sadic seized control of the project, he added mind-wiping and mental programming to the process, creating drone soldiers who followed his commands.<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" />

==Equipment==
Each Power Guard was equipped with advanced [[Armor/Legends|armor]] based on the standard [[Republic trooper]] version and also carried an advanced [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Vibrostaff/Legends|vibrostaff]] for combat.<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mark I Power Guards first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "Red Light, Black Heart" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Red Light, Black Heart" /> The Power Guard project can either be salvaged for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alignment points or destroyed for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points, but as the Jedi Knight is a Republic character and thus assumed to make only the choices that reward light-side alignment points, this article assumes that the project was destroyed.
